description: This file implements a custom guardrail handler class for the LiteLLM framework, integrating Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS API for real-time security scanning of prompts and responses. It includes methods for initializing configuration, extracting text content from messages and responses, calling the external AIRS API, applying masking, handling errors, and integrating with pre- and post-call hooks for both regular and streaming responses.

classes.name: PanwPrismaAirsHandler
classes.description: A custom guardrail handler class that interacts with Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS API to scan, mask, and enforce policies on prompts and responses within the LiteLLM framework.

methods.name: str _extract_text_from_messages(self, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Extracts text content from a list of message dicts, prioritizing the last user message.

methods.name: str _extract_text_from_content_list( self, content_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Helper to extract concatenated text from a list of content dicts in message objects.

methods.name: str _extract_response_text(self, response: ModelResponse)
methods.description: Concatenates various parts of the response (choices, tool calls, function calls) into a single text block for scanning.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _call_panw_api( self, content: str, is_response: bool = False, metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, call_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous call to the PANW Prisma AIRS API to scan content for malicious or policy-violating data.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_masked_text( self, scan_result: Dict[str, Any], is_response: bool = False )
methods.description: Retrieves masked content from the scan result, if available.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _apply_masking_to_messages( self, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], masked_text: str )
methods.description: Replaces the content of user messages with the masked text, preserving structure.

methods.name: None _apply_masking_to_response( self, response: ModelResponse, masked_text: str )
methods.description: In-place masking of the response's message content, tool call arguments, and function call arguments.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_error_detail( self, scan_result: Dict[str, Any], is_response: bool = False )
methods.description: Constructs detailed error information when a prompt or response is blocked.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] _handle_api_error_with_logging( self, scan_result: Dict[str, Any], data: Dict[str, Any], start_time: datetime, is_response: bool = False, )
methods.description: Handles errors returned from the AIRS API, logging details and raising HTTP exceptions based on transient or persistent errors.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _prepare_metadata_from_request(self, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Collects and structures metadata from the request data for use in AIRS API calls, including session IDs and profile parameters.

methods.name: bool _check_and_mark_scanned(self, data: dict, scan_type: str)
methods.description: Marks a request as scanned to prevent duplicate checks; returns True if already scanned.

methods.name: str _extract_prompt_from_request(self, data: dict)
methods.description: Extracts the user prompt text from the request data (supports message arrays and prompt fields).

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: Dict[str, Any], call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Performs a security scan of the prompt before the LLM is invoked, blocking or masking as necessary.

methods.name: Any async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: Dict[str, Any], user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response: Any, )
methods.description: Scans the LLM response after execution, blocking or masking content based on policy.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,ModelResponse,Dict[str,Any]] _scan_and_process_streaming_response( self, assembled_model_response: ModelResponse, request_data: dict, start_time: datetime, )
methods.description: Assembles and scans streaming responses, applying masking if required, and handling errors.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response: Any, request_data: dict, )
methods.description: Processes streaming chunks for scanning and masking, yielding chunks accordingly.

methods.name: Optional[Type["GuardrailConfigModel"]] get_config_model()
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class associated with this guardrail handler.
